   ```javascript
   records: {
     type: "array",

     items: {

       additionalProperties: true,
   ```

5. Commented out the problematic/unused `transformForGraph` function since it was using undefined functions.

These changes should resolve the schema validation error and allow your application to function correctly. The key fix is adding the `items` property to the array schema, which was the direct cause of the error in your API request.
